sources.flights: OpenSky Network (opensky-network.org), free public ADS-B data
sources.vessels: IMF PortWatch (portwatch.imf.org), free daily vessel-transit counts - not live AIS, see each chokepoint's own date
sources.news: Google News RSS, primary; GDELT Project tops up when available
sources.hazards: IMF PortWatch disruptions, USGS (earthquakes), NASA EONET (natural events), GDACS (disaster alerts) - all free, no key

freshness_rule: Nothing older than 7 days is published; undated items are dropped; flights are positions from this run (each at most 15 minutes old when fetched).

chokepoints.name: Strait of Hormuz
chokepoints.why: The narrow gap between Iran and Oman that oil tankers from Saudi Arabia, Iraq, the UAE, Kuwait and Qatar sail through — commonly cited as around a fifth of the world's oil consumption.
